scenario.name: Goblin Ambush

actions.rationale: 'The one directly in front' is Goblin Scout A at (20,0), straight ahead on Bram's line and the nearest foe at 20 ft. Javelin was named explicitly. This matches menu option 3 (Javelin, Mastery: slow).
actions.table_talk: Javelin's going into the goblin straight ahead. Should slow him down if it lands!
narrative_hooks: Bram Ironhand misses Goblin Scout A with Javelin (6 vs AC 15).

actions.rationale: Human spent Heroic Inspiration to reroll.
narrative_hooks: Bram Ironhand spends Heroic Inspiration to reroll Javelin (previous total 6).
Bram Ironhand hits Goblin Scout A with Javelin (18 vs AC 15) for 4 piercing damage.
Slow mastery reduces Goblin Scout A's speed by 10 ft until start of Bram Ironhand's next turn.

actions.rationale: 'Got him!' is ambiguous. It may be a celebration rather than a new action. I read it as pressing in on the nearest foe, Goblin Scout A (20 ft), and chose menu option 1 to close to 5 ft. No enemy is in reach yet, so an attack wasn't legal. If the player meant to end their turn, option 4 applies instead.
actions.table_talk: I'm on Scout A, moving in!

actions.rationale: Casting Mage Armor to raise unarmored AC to 13 + DEX.
actions.table_talk: Weaving Mage Armor before pressing the attack!
narrative_hooks: Talia Spark casts Mage Armor on Talia Spark (AC 13 + DEX).
Round 1: Goblin Scout B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Firing ranged Shortbow at Talia Spark.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Scout B misses Talia Spark with Shortbow (6 vs AC 15).
Round 1: Goblin Scout A's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Attacking Bram Ironhand in melee with Scimitar.
narrative_hooks: Goblin Scout A misses Bram Ironhand with Scimitar (11 vs AC 19).

actions.rationale: Human chose [1]: Attack Goblin Scout A with Longsword (5 ft, Mastery: sap)
narrative_hooks: Goblin Scout A drops to 0 HP and is defeated.
Bram Ironhand hits Goblin Scout A with Longsword (23 vs AC 15) for 6 slashing damage.
Sap mastery gives Goblin Scout A Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

actions.rationale: Bram has no block or interpose action, so the closest legal option is menu 1: move to (25,10), 5 ft from Goblin Scout B. This engages the goblin and puts Bram in its path, so leaving would provoke an opportunity attack. The move costs 10 ft of his 30.
actions.table_talk: I'm stepping up on the last goblin. Talia, stay behind me, it'll have to get past me first!

actions.rationale: Casting magic-missile (slot 1) on Goblin Scout B (10.5 eff avg).
actions.table_talk: Focusing magic-missile on Goblin Scout B!
narrative_hooks: Talia Spark casts Magic Missile at Goblin Scout B for 11 force damage.
Goblin Scout B drops to 0 HP and is defeated.
